The **Single Action Revolver** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*.

The revolver is a single action model and has the words "U.S." inscribed on the side. The gun uses .44 Rounds. When reloading, the cylinder is loaded one round at a time and it is rotated before loading each new cartridge, with the reload process being interruptible. The single action revolver deals slightly more damage than the .44 pistol, has good accuracy but a low fire rate and a very limited number of modifications.
